problems.summary: Arch's own ESX 1.1.1 to 1.2.2 upgrade injected 18 to 20 framework-owned disposition targets into every one of the six open issues, because FRAMEWORK_PATHS participates in the inventory a candidate diff is computed over. For 1DMIX-055 that is its entire diff, so closing it would require asserting documentation accuracy for tools/esx symbols it never touched.
problems.evidence: Measured directly with doc_contract.draft against each issue's pinned baseline: 1DMIX-055 18 targets of which 18 framework-owned, 1DMIX-054 36/18, 1DMIX-059 56/19, 1DMIX-058 71/19, 1DMIX-057 75/19, 1DMIX-052 102/20. FRAMEWORK_PATHS is ['tools/esx', '.claude', 'devel-loop', 'docs', 'esx', 'CLAUDE.md', '.gitignore']. The upgrade changed team_budget.py, brief.py, agent_runtime.py, team_driver.py, ralph_stop.py and devel-loop/team_operations.md. Before the upgrade 1DMIX-055's diff would have been one target, docs/code_map.md; its own deliverables sit outside every scanned root and contribute none.

problems.summary: Arch recommended retire-and-refile to the Owner as a cheap way to close a long-open issue, and the Owner approved it, before Arch had checked that any move to closed runs the full gate. loop_lifecycle's own docstring says promotion runs the full gate, so retirement is exactly as expensive as ordinary closure and the recommendation could not have worked as described.
problems.evidence: loop_lifecycle.py module docstring: 'Promotion stages the ledgers and runs the full gate; check-done records the accepted iteration afterwards.' records.py permits only 'resolved' and 'false positive' for a closed entry, so there is no lighter-weight retired state either. Arch proposed the route in one turn and discovered the contradiction in the next, after the Owner had already approved it.

solutions.reason: Filed this iteration with the six-issue measurement. The fix needs a decision about whether three-way-merge results are attributable from the deployment record, which is analysis rather than scientific work, and it touches a documentation-integrity mechanism so it should not be changed unilaterally.

Same owner as the other occurrences of asserting before measuring. This instance is worse than those because the unverified claim was a recommendation to the Owner that shaped a decision, rather than a figure in a brief.

carry_forward: Verify a route exists before recommending it to the Owner: read the mechanism that would have to permit it, not just the one that blocks the current path. A recommendation the Owner approves and Arch then retracts costs more than the measurement would have.
Apply a framework upgrade when few issues are open, or expect it to enlarge every open issue's candidate diff by the number of framework symbols it changes.
